title: Mon 23 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang and US stocks jumped (S&P ~+5%, VIX ~27 from 35.9); oil fell again (WTI ~$81); flash PMIs mixed (euro area 51.7 flat, France 46.2, UK 52.3, US 54.6); Pill wants action now. No score changes; risk-on meets written conditions for AUD, NZD and JPY.
[b]Next:[/b] Tue 24 Nov German Ifo 11:00, BoE Greene 14:30, US consumer confidence 17:00, BoC Macklem 19:40; Wed 25 Nov Australia CPI 02:30, US GDP + PCE 15:30.

USD.note: Fed December hike still ~96% priced; soft US services PMI (54.7 vs 55.7) is MEDIUM, no score effect.

EUR.note: Euro-area flash composite flat at 51.7; France 46.2 vs 48.1 expected (MEDIUM); oil lower again helps the importer.

GBP.note: Pill: "we do need to take action now" (no December reference); UK flash output 52.3 from 52.9, so the strong-PMI condition is not met.

JPY.note: Written yen-weakening condition "a sharp risk-on rebound" met intraday (S&P ~+5%, VIX ~27); Tokyo closed; shadow unchanged.

CHF.note: VIX fell to ~27 from 35.9: no longer above 30, not yet under the 25 line of the franc-weakening condition.

CAD.note: WTI ~$81 and Brent ~$88 (down 3–4%) on a risk-on day; no written US–Canada deal; Macklem Tue 19:40.

AUD.note: Written Aussie strength condition "risk-on rebound" met intraday; CPI Wed 02:30 pending; shadow unchanged.

NZD.note: Carried from the morning (retail +2.2% vs +0.5%), now joined by the risk-on rebound; shadow unchanged (MEDIUM release).

XAU.note: Gold ~$3,663 (+4.2%) is price context only; no ETF, central-bank or real-yield data; G +1.
